ERB Growth Model Development
Analyses and Initial Results
Damian Betebenner — Center for Assessment

August 1st, 2022

Data preparation
• Reading Comprehension data was received from ERB:
• Fall 2019-2020: 49,582 student records
• Fall 2020-2021: 73,230 student records
• Spring 2020-2021: 118,071 student records
• Spring 2021-2022: 142,165 student records
• Data including unique student identifiers, test level, grade enrolled, date
student tested.
• The data contained a minor number of students with more than a single record
in the testing window: 370 cases
• The students last test score in the testing window (season) was utilized as
their valid scale score

Data preparation
• LONG formatted data was produced as the first step in SGP
analyses.
• The R script utilized or data preparation is available here:

SGP Analyses
• With data prepared, the next step is to run SGP analyses using
this data.
• Two sets of analyses were conducted based upon discussions of
student test taking:
• Fall 2019-2020 to Fall 2020-2021
• Spring 2020-2021 to Spring 2020-2021
• Specifying these analyses is done through configurations available
here.

SGP Analyses
• As a first step we calculate SGPs for students based upon the
configurations specified.
• The SGP model utilized for ERB Reading Comprehension data
takes account of:
• The student’s prior score
• The date in which the student took their test in the current
window
• The time span between when they took their current test and
when they took their prior test

SGP Analyses
• As a first step we calculate SGPs for students based upon the
configurations specified.
• The SGP model utilized for ERB Reading Comprehension data takes
account of:
• The student’s prior score
• The date in which the student took their test in the current window
• The time span between when they took their current test and
when they took their prior test
• The R script utilized to run the SGP analyses is available here.

SGP Analyses
• Analyses ran with no errors and SGPs were produced for all
cohorts.
• NOTE: There was no Fall Grade 1 data in the files.
• NOTE: There was no Grade 12 data in the files.
• Goodness of fit results are presented on the following slides
